summary: Lando Norris hunts a second consecutive victory from pole position at the treacherous new Madrid circuit, where McLaren's qualifying masterclass must translate into race craft against Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and Max Verstappen's Red Bull on a track that punishes mistakes. George Russell warns the high-risk layout could shake up grid order dramatically, handing an unexpected opportunity to any driver who threads the needle through its most dangerous corners. A dominant performance by either McLaren or Mercedes this weekend would seize crucial momentum in a championship fight that has tightened considerably.
